<thought>Analyzed the isotopic envelope: the decreasing intensities at ~1 Da intervals (≈11 % for +1, 0.5 % for +2, 0.016 % for +3) match the binomial distribution of 13C in a molecule with ~10 carbons. No other common element shows this pattern (Cl, Br have 2 Da spacing; N, S, etc. have much lower +1 intensities). Therefore carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the observed isotope distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
